document.text:
Gene expression begins when RNA polymerase binds near a gene in DNA. During transcription, RNA polymerase uses the DNA sequence as a template to create messenger RNA. The messenger RNA then leaves the nucleus and carries the encoded information to a ribosome.

During translation, the ribosome reads messenger RNA and joins amino acids into a polypeptide. Transfer RNA brings particular amino acids to the ribosome. The order of codons in messenger RNA determines the order of amino acids in the polypeptide.

The polypeptide folds into a functional protein. Regulatory proteins can increase or decrease transcription by affecting whether RNA polymerase binds, so regulation of transcription changes how much protein the cell produces without changing the DNA sequence.

entities.name: Gene expression
entities.description: Process by which information in DNA is used to produce a functional protein.

entities.name: RNA polymerase
entities.description: Enzyme that binds near a gene and uses DNA as a template during transcription.

entities.name: DNA
entities.description: Molecule containing the gene sequence used as a template during transcription.

entities.name: Transcription
entities.description: Process in which RNA polymerase uses a DNA sequence to create messenger RNA.

entities.name: Messenger RNA
entities.description: RNA molecule that carries encoded information from the nucleus to a ribosome.

entities.name: Nucleus
entities.description: Cellular compartment from which messenger RNA exits before carrying information to a ribosome.

entities.name: Ribosome
entities.description: Cellular structure that reads messenger RNA and joins amino acids into a polypeptide.

entities.name: Translation
entities.description: Process in which a ribosome reads messenger RNA and joins amino acids into a polypeptide.

entities.name: Transfer RNA
entities.description: RNA molecule that brings particular amino acids to the ribosome.

entities.name: Amino acid
entities.description: Molecular building block joined into a polypeptide during translation.

entities.name: Polypeptide
entities.description: Chain of amino acids produced during translation that folds into a functional protein.

entities.name: Codon
entities.description: Unit in messenger RNA whose order determines the order of amino acids in the polypeptide.

entities.name: Functional protein
entities.description: Protein produced when a polypeptide folds into its functional form.

entities.name: Regulatory protein
entities.description: Protein that can increase or decrease transcription by affecting RNA polymerase binding.

entities.name: Regulation of transcription
entities.description: Control of transcription through effects on whether RNA polymerase binds near a gene.

entities.name: Protein amount produced by the cell
entities.description: Quantity of protein produced by the cell, which is changed by transcriptional regulation.
